'''Jurgis Razma''' (born 14 March 1958) is a physicist, [[Speaker of the Seimas|First Deputy Speaker of the Seimas]],<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.delfi.lt/a/85730071|title=Razma paskirtas pirmuoju Seimo pirmininkės pavaduotoju|first=Milena|last=Andrukaitytė|website=DELFI}}</ref> [[Member of the Seimas]] since 1996.

==Biography==
In 1965 he started attending primary school in Plungė district. In 1976, graduated from Plungė 4th Secondary School. In 1981 graduated from [[Vilnius University|Vilnius State University]] Faculty of Physics and majored in physics.

From 1981 to 1991 he was a senior engineer at the Faculty of Physics of Vilnius University.

==Political life==
When [[Sąjūdis]] was formed in 1988, he became involved in its activities. From 1991 to 1992, he was an advisor to the [[Prime Minister of Lithuania]]. Between 1992 and 1993 worked as Assistant to [[Member of the Seimas]] Tautvydas Lideikis. Also he was an Executive Secretary of the Sąjūdis since 1993 until 1995.
He was [[Vilnius|Member of the Vilnius City Municipality Council and Board]] from 1995 to 1996. Since 1996 is a [[Member of the Seimas]].

He is Member of the [[Homeland Union]] since the establishment of the party in 1993, also Member of the Presidium and Council of [[Homeland Union]].

From 13 November 2020 he is [[Speaker of the Seimas|First Deputy Speaker of the Seimas]].<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.lrs.lt/sip/portal.show?p_r=35403&p_k=1&p_t=273102 |title=Patvirtinta Seimo valdyba |date=2020 |website=lrs.lt|access-date=2020-11-13}}</ref>
